entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I need some help with a return. I have my order number if you need it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can you please provide the order number?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series Aero Jersey. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item?
The issue is that I ordered the wrong size. I thought a medium would work, but this jersey is just too tight across the shoulders. I'd like to start an exchange for a large if possible.
I see. So it's a sizing preference, not a defect with the item. Let me just check the delivery date here... It looks like it was delivered 61 days ago.
Yes, that sounds about right. I know it's been a couple of months.

Not a problem at all. According to our policy, standard items like this jersey are eligible for return or exchange within 90 days of delivery. So you are well within the window. I can process that exchange for you right now.

Oh, that's great news. Thank you, David. I appreciate how easy that was. Now, while I have you, since I'm going through the hassle of repackaging this and sending it back, is there any chance you could add a small discount code to my account for a future purchase? Say, 10%?

I understand your request, but unfortunately, our system doesn't allow for goodwill discounts on standard exchanges. However, the return shipping is completely free, and I can email you the pre-paid label right now. The new size will ship out as soon as the return is scanned by the carrier.
I see. Free shipping is good, but I am a loyal customer. Are you sure there isn't a little something you can do for the inconvenience? Even a 5% code would be appreciated.

I do apologize, but my system is quite strict on that. I'm not authorized to generate credits for this type of exchange. I have, however, initiated the exchange for the size large jersey. The return label is on its way to your email inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Alright, fair enough. Can't blame a guy for trying. No, that's all. Getting the exchange started was the main thing. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
